name: BENZOLUM
key_symptoms: Sense of falling through bed and floor. Pains from below upward. Tired and nervous.
Frontal headache to root of nose. Dizzy. Pressing feeling in head. Right sided headache.
Heavy limbs, cold legs, exaggerated knee-jerk. Pains from below upward.
guiding_symptoms: Sense of falling through bed and floor. Pains from below upward. Tired and nervous.

head_symptoms: Sense of falling through bed and floor. Pains from below upward. Tired and nervous.
Frontal headache to root of nose. Dizzy. Pressing feeling in head. Right sided headache.
urinary_symptoms: Swelling of right testicle. Severe pain in testicles. Itching of scrotum. Profuse urination.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Heavy limbs, cold legs, exaggerated knee-jerk. Pains from below upward.
skin_symptoms: Eruption like measles. Perspiration on side not lain upon. Itching all over back.
